brief: The canvas displays an intricate interplay between naturally occurring organic structures and glowing geometric patterns. Petrified mangrove root systems form the underlying, stable texture against a dark, deep-sea background. Superimposed on this natural base are self-organized vector schematics—glowing, luminous lines of circuitry. These schematic lines are constantly animated, expanding, contracting, and shifting in a highly rhythmic fashion, driven by the cyclical sweep of an invisible pendulum. The entire composition moves perpetually, creating the illusion of deep-sea bioluminescence interacting with ancient, geological time.

statement: This sketch portrays an underwater ecosystem where ancient petrified mangrove roots form a stable foundation against a dark ocean backdrop. Superimposed on this geological base are glowing lines that pulse and shift rhythmically, mimicking the behavior of biological neural networks or circuitry. The animation is driven by an invisible pendulum that creates a steady, hypnotic motion—each line responds to this rhythmic force as it moves through space, creating a visual metaphor for deep-sea bioluminescence interacting with timeless geological structures. The interplay between organic and geometric elements suggests the convergence of life and time within an oceanic environment.
